title: Expose pending publish autonomy byte budget settings
summary: Expose AutonomyPendingTotalReviewBytes and AutonomyPendingTotalBlockBytes as validated Advanced Settings controls for Pending Publish byte budgets.
reason: Operators can have enough scratch disk space while the backend still blocks launches because parked Pending Publish bytes exceed the autonomy byte budget. The byte thresholds already drive backend diagnostics, but they were not easy to discover or edit from Settings.
behavior_before: Pending Publish byte-budget launch gates were consumed by backend autonomy diagnostics, but the byte thresholds were not part of the managed Settings contract or visible Advanced Settings controls. Operators had to use raw/direct config edits for the budget values.
behavior_after: AutonomyPendingTotalReviewBytes and AutonomyPendingTotalBlockBytes are managed config keys with typed defaults, numeric bounds, Advanced Settings Long-Run Reliability metadata, PowerShell config/schema registry coverage, generated JSON schema entries, inventory documentation, and explicit numeric-policy tests. The controls only change launch-gate diagnostics policy; they do not drain, repair, publish, move, or mutate parked Pending Publish payloads.
manual_validation: CONFIG_FIELD_DEFINITIONS spot-check for AutonomyPendingTotalReviewBytes/AutonomyPendingTotalBlockBytes Advanced Long-Run Reliability controls - passed
rollback_plan: Remove the two AutonomyPendingTotal* fields from the Python config contract, key order/constants, metadata, numeric policy, generated schemas, PowerShell config registries/defaults/templates/runtime loader, docs inventories, generated summaries, and the focused numeric-policy assertions. Backend autonomy diagnostics will fall back to their existing hard-coded defaults when the keys are absent.
notes:
Expose pending-publish autonomy byte budgets as Advanced Settings controls while preserving backend-owned diagnostics and pending-publish drain boundaries.
mediapipeline.tools.dev.refresh_summaries --check still reports pre-existing unrelated stale/missing summaries outside this settings change; touched-file summaries were refreshed.
